jonah (releases): Quick plan for tonight's orders migration in the 02:00 UTC change window. small additive column + backfill. Need rollout notes and an escape hatch.

maya (DB): Can we avoid long exclusive locks? thinking COPY pattern + atomic swap. backfill in small batches by tenant id.

sara (eng-sre): If we do batched backfill, let's gate by outlier latency and have a 15m holdpoint after first shard. I'll set SLO alerts to high sensitivity for that window.

kyle (platform): We should pin the worker service to v2.3.1 during the window so background writes don't start using new column prematurely. also add a feature-flag toggle for reading from the new column.

jonah (releases): Agreed. Rollout strategy: canary 1% traffic -> 10% -> 100% after successful backfills and 15m stable at each step. If anything spikes, immediate rollback to reading old column and cancel remaining backfills.

maya (DB): Backfill script (will run on migration host) uses tenant batching and sleeps between batches. snippet:
```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN qty_shipped bigint DEFAULT 0;
-- backfill job will populate temp_orders.qty_shipped_copy then swap
COMMIT;
```
We'll run backfill jobs with concurrency=4 and batch_size=5000.

sara (eng-sre): I'll deploy traffic shaper rules to route 1% to canary instances and monitor p50/p95/p99. If p99 > 400ms or error rate > 0.5% revert traffic.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: migration/orders-add-qty-shipped at 2098765800. Link: https://deploys.redwood/internal/2098765800

kyle (platform): Release notes we should include: downtime=no, write-locks=possible short exclusive on shard during index create, backfill=online with rate-limit. Also mention manual rollback steps and required service version pin.

jonah (releases): Escape hatch steps (short):
1) disable backfill jobs via ops console
2) flip feature flag to old-column reads
3) revert worker service to pinned image (v2.3.1)
4) if schema partially applied, run cleanup job to drop transient temp columns

maya (DB): I'll be watching the migration logs. If we see >0.1% deadlocks or unexpected lock waits > 30s we abort.

sara (eng-sre): Confirmed — I set two alert channels: #oncall and #releases-incidents. I'll also have a runbook open.

jonah (releases): Good. Post-mortem checklist: collect query profiles, KV cache hit rates, migration logs, and canary metrics. I'll draft release notes and push to docs before EOD. :+1: :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: migration/orders-add-qty-shipped SUCCESS at 2098766045. Artifacts: s3://redwood-deploys/migration-orders-2098765800.log

kyle (platform): Next steps: run the staged backfill for tenant group A during the 02:20 UTC holdpoint, then evaluate. If all green, promote canary and continue.
